name: git_pull
description: Fetch + integrate a remote branch (rebase default; fail-soft on conflict). Input: repoPath, remote?, branch?, rebase?.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the git checkout to pull into.

branch.description: Branch name to pull. Defaults to the checkout's current branch when omitted.

rebase.description: Integrate with `git pull --rebase` when true (default), `--no-rebase` (merge) when false.

pulled.description: True if the pull integrated cleanly; false if it hit conflicts (fail-soft: the rebase/merge is aborted, not left wedged).

conflicts.description: Conflicted paths when pulled=false; empty array when pulled=true.

head.description: HEAD commit SHA of the checkout after the operation.
